text: I'm looking after my grandson, he's 6. He's got some little dark red spots, tiny like pinpricks, on his legs and a couple on his tummy. I think I pressed a glass on them like you're meant to and I'm fairly sure they didn't go away, they stayed just as dark. I might be doing it wrong, I'm not certain. I've been up most of the night and I'm worn out so I'd rather someone told me
